notes.title: Chimera: Patch #2
notes.content:
Thank you for all the feedback you all have given us in the last couple weeks since our launch. We have continued to review all your comments and concerns and have worked hard at this new patch. Here’s what’s been changed for version [b]1.0.4:[/b]

[h2][b]Changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added small, wandering grubs in the first floor that heal you when you squish ‘em
[*] Relic shop cutscene now plays after the first completed run
[*] Relic shop cutscene, archives cutscene, and bone room cutscene are all now skippable
[*] Body shop cutscene now is the second cutscene in the game’s progression
[*] Changed the skip dialogue button on Keyboard & Mouse to “SPACE” instead of “ENTER”
[*] Adjusted the pickup indicator for Keyboard & Mouse and the Body Shop
[*] Adjusted rendering of enemies so they can be seen through foreground elements
[*] Adjusted rendering of boss drops so they can be seen through foreground elements
[*] Adjusted bullet crab shockwave collider to align more closely with its VFX
[*] Body shop on any floor is now inaccessible until your second run
[*] Redesigned the Post-run Summary menu to properly fit trinkets and separated the relic
[/list]
[h2][b]Balance changes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced damage and health scaling for creatures
[*] Slightly increased player base movement speed
[*] Increased major creature essence drop from 20 to 30
[*] Changed Plump Mushroom to increase 10 flat HP instead of 10%
[*] Impenetrable Wings ability speed increase reduced from 7% to 4%
[*] Mule’s Kick movement speed increase reduced from 20% to 10%
[*] Reduced cost of Vital Core from 500 to 200
[*] Reduced cost of Bone Hoarder from 1250 to 500
[*] Increased Bone Hoarder damage gained from 5% to 10%
[*] Reduced cost of Fragile Confidence from 1500 to 1000
[*] Reduced cost of Raven’s Gifts from 2000 to 1500
[*] Increased cost reduction of Raven’s Gifts from 40% to 30%
[*] Reduced cost of Mutated Evolution from 2500 to 1500
[*] Reduced cost of Whale’s Fortitude from 3000 to 2000
[*] Increased Whale’s Fortitude damage reduction from 20% to 30%
[/list]
[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Echidna's Blessing appearing in the Relic Shop before acquiring it in the story
[*] Fixed relic not properly persisting between runs (for real this time)
[*] Fixed the Amalgamation not properly executing its death sequence when defeated (for real this time, we hope)
[*] Fixed the left arm not displaying stats in the Body menu on Mouse & Keyboard
[*] Fixed the “view menu” prompt from softlocking you during the tutorial
[*] Fixed input device swapping for lore drop pickups and the lore drops in the codex
[*] Fixed scrolling not working in the codex or the post-run summary
[*] Adjusted out of bounds detection to help prevent players getting knocked out through closed doors
[*] Fixed Katayama’s spin attack projectiles from disappearing randomly
[*] Fixed settings not saving/persisting between gameplay sessions or defaulting properly
[*] Fixed The Wardens boss music quality and made its loop smoother
[*] Fixed Plump Mushroom not properly increasing its heals when stacked
[*] Fixed the Post-run Summary menu’s trinket navigability on controller
[/list]

notes.title: Chimera: Patch #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
First, we want to thank everyone for playing our game and giving us so much feedback! We are very appreciative of all the bugs and issues that are being reported so we can improve the experience.

We have worked really hard to iron out a lot of issues that many players have pointed out. 
So, let's get started on what's new for version [b]1.0.3:[/b]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated spike traps, increased visibility and added animation delay when stepped on.
[*] Adjusted spike trap locations, and removed many in multiple rooms
[*] Adjusted bullet crab to have rotation speed instead of snapping to their target (you are the target)
[*] Adjusted bullet crab shockwave only triggering when player is within range
[*] Adjusted the Warden's healing from 100% to 50%
[*] Added bones automatically being picked up when leaving the room
[*] Reduced the hitbox when a crocodile resurfaces when it does its burrow attack 
[*] Removed all colliders on dead ravens in the nest, you can walk through them AND shoot through them now (sorry for that one)
[*] Relics now stay equipped between runs, no more having to run to the relic shop real quick!
[*] Frog legs and croc legs do not slow you down (we know they're not very popular)
[*] Gecko legs reduced puddle count from 8 to 5 (sorry gecko leg enjoyers)
[/list]

[b]We also adjusted the hitboxes for our core gameplay:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased range of core head hitbox
[*] Increased range of core arms hitbox
[*] Increased range of croc head hitbox
[*] Increased range of wolf arms hitbox
[*] Increased range of rhino arms hitbox
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed Achievements: Snap N' Slap, Graftless, and ABOMINATION (sorry to all of you who feel robbed)
[*] Fixed the limb swap menu not showing a keybind for Scrapping limbs
[*] Fixed glow on hover for keyboard and mouse in the trinket menu
[*] Fixed head healthbar UI defaulting to white after a cutscene
[*] Fixed bullet crab sometimes getting stuck and animation locked after being attacked or hit by a trap (he gets a little nervous)
[*] Fixed limb swap menu inputs
[*] Fixed pick up prompts not popping up when approaching Raven or pick ups
[*] Fixed AMALGAMATION cutscene not triggering after defeating it (we think, please let us know if it's fixed)
[*] Fixed some lore drop text not properly placed within the sprites
[*] Fixed shop bone scaling from 1.5x to 1.3x per floor (break the pots will you?!)
[/list]

We are aware of other issues within the game and are working hard to address them and create other quality of life updates. 

Thank you again for playing our game, and we hope to see everyone escape the tower :)
